MP3 encoding uses the unmodified lamejs 1.2.1 JavaScript port of LAME.
Project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
License: LGPL-3.0 (see LGPL-3.0.txt and lame-LICENSE.txt).
Corresponding distributed source: lame-1.2.1.source.js
The encoder is loaded as a separate script by mp3-worker.js.
